turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Of course. The key point is position: always, usually, sometimes and never come before the main verb, but after the verb be (She is always late). And don't forget the -s for he, she and it.

Here is your first task. Put the adverb in the right place and fix any other mistake:
"My dad watch TV never after dinner."
